item.title: CMBS Distress Rate Could Reach 15% by Year End: CRED iQ
item.description: CRED iQ projects the overall distress rate for commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) could reach 14.5 to 15 percent by December as persistent headwinds continue pressuring commercial real estate borrowers.
